hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Moodle for werewolf's moodle form, as Wolfi would package it: the release tarball, checked by sha256 (Moodle publishes it beside the tarball), laid in /usr/share/moodle. It is PHP, so nothing is compiled; the form names the PHP it runs on. 5.3 is a long-term release, secured into October 2029: a new Moodle upgrades its tables one way, so a slot rolled back must still read them, and minor releases alone keep that. A new long-term release is a new recipe. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
